segments.zh: 好吧，在我们看这个日期语言之前，让我们第一次听对话。

segments.en: They were relieved to hear that the company would not be making any layoffs.
segments.zh: 听到该公司不会裁员，他们松了一口气。

segments.en: I'm so relieved to hear your voice.
segments.zh: 听到你的声音，我松了一口气。

segments.en: I was worried something happened to you.
I guess relieved is like a happy or relaxed feeling that you get if you avoid something bad, right?
segments.zh: 我想如果你避免坏事，你会得到一种快乐或放松的感觉，对吧？

segments.en: I'm so relieved that didn't happen.

segments.zh: 现在我们的第二个字，来接我。

segments.en: So when you ask someone to pick you up, you're saying basically...
segments.zh: 所以当你要求别人来接你时，你基本上是在说...

segments.en: My husband was supposed to pick me up from work yesterday, but he forgot.
segments.zh: 我丈夫昨天应该下班来接我，但他忘记了。

segments.en: All right, we'll have a talk with him.

segments.zh: 或者我们也可以说，哦，我需要快点。

segments.en: The taxi will pick me up at seven.
segments.zh: 出租车将在七点来接我。

segments.en: And our final word in today's language takeaway is...
segments.zh: 我们在今天的语言中的最后一句话是...

segments.en: So, ordinary is a normal word.
segments.zh: 所以，普通是一个普通的词。

segments.en: So you can have like an ordinary person.
segments.zh: 所以你可以像普通人一样拥有。

segments.zh: 一个普通的播客，英语播客不是。

看起来像一场注定要失败的婚姻。

segments.en: So Erica, what is a twist of fate?
segments.zh: 那么埃里卡，命运的转折是什么？

segments.en: A twist of fate is an unplanned event that has a big impact on your future or your life.
segments.zh: 命运的转折是对您的未来或生活产生重大影响的计划外事件。

segments.en: Marco, can you give us an example of a twist of fate?
segments.zh: 马可，你能给我们举一个命运转折的例子吗？

segments.en: Okay, you're supposed to catch a flight to another country, all right?
segments.zh: 好吧，你应该赶上另一个国家的航班，好吗？

segments.en: But you're late, so you miss your flight.
segments.zh: 但是你迟到了，所以你错过了你的航班。

segments.en: Right, so that's a twist of fate.
segments.zh: 对，所以这是命运的转折。

segments.en: So yeah, it's like fate, it's like destiny.
segments.zh: 所以，是的，就像命运一样，就像命运一样。

segments.en: You weren't supposed to be on that flight.
segments.zh: 你不应该在那个航班上。

segments.en: Erica, I know you have a story of a twist of fate in your life.
segments.zh: 埃里卡，我知道你的生活中有一个关于命运的转折的故事。

segments.en: I went to this party and at the party there was a contest, like sort of a lottery.
segments.zh: 我参加了这个聚会，在聚会上有一场比赛，就像是一种彩票。

segments.en: You could buy some tickets and win a prize and the prize was a week-long vacation.
segments.zh: 您可以购买一些门票并赢取奖品，奖品是为期一周的假期。

segments.en: So I went with some friends of mine and they were tired so they left early and they gave me their tickets.
segments.zh: 所以我和我的一些朋友一起去了，他们很累，所以他们早早离开了，他们把票给了我。
我们赢得了为期一周的假期。

segments.en: So that was a really lucky twist of fate for me.

segments.en: I'm sure it wasn't that good of a twist of fate for your friends.
